modes.name: Shiyu Defense: Critical Node
sharedMechanics: In this stage, dealing DMG to enemies earns you DMG Score. Defeating a single normal/elite enemy will grant you an instance of Elimination Score.
In this stage, scores earned at different times will receive additional multiplier bonuses. The earlier in the challenge, the higher the multiplier. The total score cap (including bonus) is 50,000.

bosses.name: Metamorphosed - Avarus
mechanics: Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt by Agents increases by 15%.
If there are 2/3 Agents in the squad with Anomaly specialty, Agent Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40/120 pts.

bosses.name: A-H0L0 Type Intelligent Tactical Construct - Mirage Archer Unit
mechanics: When Agents inflict an Attribute Anomaly on enemies, their DEF is reduced by 15%, and All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

A-H0L0 Type Intelligent Tactical Construct - Mirage Archer Unit

bosses.name: Thracian
mechanics: When an Agent with Attack specialty lands Basic Attack, it ignores 30% of enemy Ice RES.
After an Agent with Attack specialty uses a Chain Attack or EX Special Attack, their Ice DMG increases by 20% and CRIT DMG increases by 40% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

selectableBuffs.name: Icy Raid
selectableBuffs.description: DMG dealt by Agents' Basic Attack and Ultimate increases by 30%. When an Agent with Attack specialty hits an enemy, their attacks ignore 20% of the target's Ice RES. · After an Agent uses an EX Special Attack, their own Ice DMG increases by 30% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

selectableBuffs.name: Mutation II
selectableBuffs.description: If there are 2/3 Agents with Anomaly specialty in your squad, the whole squad's Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10%/30%, and their ATK increases by 5%/15% respectively. · When dealing Attribute Anomaly DMG to an enemy, ignore 10% of their All-Attribute RES and 10% of their DEF.

selectableBuffs.name: Heartcrusher
selectableBuffs.description: Agent CRIT DMG increases by 30%. · ATK of Agents with Attack specialty increases by 10%. Their Basic Attack DMG increases by 30% and ignore 15% of enemy DEF.

bosses.name: Dead End Butcher
mechanics: When not in a Stunned state, Boss enemies gain 1 stack of All or Nothing every 6s, stacking up to 3 stacks. Each stack of All or Nothing increases the DMG dealt by the Boss enemy by 10%. When an Agent's attack hits an enemy, for each stack of All or Nothing the target has, CRIT DMG from the Agent's attacks increases by 25% and Attribute Anomaly DMG decreases by 15%. When an enemy enters a Stunned state, they gain 1 stack of All or Nothing. All or Nothing stacks will be reset when the enemy recovers from being Stunned.
Successfully triggering Perfect Dodge or Perfect Assist grants 300 Performance Points. A maximum of 5,000 Performance Points can be obtained.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Girtablullu
mechanics: Whenever an Agent inflicts an Anomaly on the Boss, they apply 1 stack of Shadow to it. Each stack of Shadow increases the Boss's Anomaly DMG taken by 7.5% and additionally increases its Vortex DMG taken by 5% for 10s. Shadow can stack up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. During Corruptive Barrier, applying Shadow to the Boss additionally reduces the Corruptive Barrier by 20% of its max value and accumulates 15% Daze (cannot be repeatedly triggered within 15s). When the Corruptive Barrier is broken, the Boss immediately gains max stacks of Shadow. When the Boss is Stunned, all Shadow stacks are removed and an equal number of Laceration stacks are applied. Each stack of Laceration reduces the Boss's Anomaly Buildup RES by 5% and increases its Stun DMG Multiplier by 10%. When the Boss's Stunned state ends, all Laceration stacks are removed.

Each successful parry against Girtablullu's consecutive downward smashes after it activates Corruptive Barrier grants 1,000 Performance Points. Successfully triggering a Chain Parry against the final slam grants an additional 1,000 Performance Points. Successfully breaking the Corruptive Barrier grants 1,500 Performance Points. Maximum obtainable Performance Points: 5,000.
Suitable for Agents with Anomaly specialty.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Primordial Nightmare - "The Creator"
mechanics: Boss Anomaly DMG taken is reduced by 30%. When switching from Miasmic Shield state to normal state, or from normal state to Miasmic Shield state, Agent CRIT DMG against them is increased by 20%. This effect can stack up to 3 times and resets when the boss recovers from Stun.

Triggering Miasmic Shield Purification grants 1,000 Performance Points. During the Control Skill, each successful counter against the Boss's attacks grants 500 Performance Points. Performing a Shutdown on the Boss's Control Skill grants 2,000 Performance Points. Maximum obtainable Performance Points: 5,000.
Suitable for Agents with Attack specialty.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Rewritten - Sanguine Sweeper
mechanics: When an Agent lands Shutdown on an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 10%, Agents with Attack specialty gain 20% bonus ATK, 25% bonus PEN Ratio, and their Ice and Ether CRIT DMG increases by 60%. Upon triggering a special stagger, the whole squad's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40 pts and their Anomaly DMG increases by 30%.

Each successful counter and subsequent trigger of a special stagger against the Boss's attacks grants 1,000 Performance Points. During the Control Skill, each successful counter against the Boss's attacks grants 500 Performance Points. Performing a Shutdown on the Boss's Control Skill grants 1,500 Performance Points. Maximum obtainable Performance Points: 5,000.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 10,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 30,000 points within the time limit
